tasks.title: Create LoyaltyTransaction model + migration + backfill
tasks.description: TD-030 — app/api/marketplace/loyalty/route.ts references a LoyaltyTransaction model that does not exist in schema. Points history is lost; only the running balance is stored in Customer.loyaltyPoints. Create the model, migration, backfill synthetic transactions from current balances, and rewire the route. Blueprint: docs/adr/024-loyalty-transaction-model.md (Alpha, 2026-04-09).
tasks.review_notes: PASS. All 7 files verified by Gamma against ADR-024 and CLAUDE.md rules. Schema shape exact, hand-written migration SQL matches project style, ILoyaltyDB tenantId-first, LoyaltyDB uses atomic prisma.\$transaction([insert, increment]) in earn AND redeem, cross-tenant guard, cache invalidation, error classes, fire-and-forget activity log. Route uses Zod safeParse + requireAdmin. Backfill idempotent + paginated. 6 tests real (earn, redeem happy, redeem insufficient, cross-tenant, pagination, backfill idempotency). Meta-orchestrator verified: tsc clean, vitest 6/6 in 1.88s. ⚠ PROD MIGRATION NOT APPLIED — Brandon to run DATABASE_URL=\$DIRECT_URL npx prisma migrate deploy + scripts/backfill-loyalty-transactions.ts in a maintenance window. Follow-ups deferred to new tasks: TASK-006 (race condition in redemption: balance check outside $transaction), TASK-007 (drift migration: 2 sites still write Customer.loyaltyPoints directly — customers.db.ts:216, orders/route.ts:204). Non-blocking: F1 missing 'owner' role in requireAdmin per ADR §Step 6 — add in TASK-006. F2 offset pagination acceptable for v1.

tasks.title: Fix concurrent redemption race + add 'owner' role to loyalty routes
tasks.description: Gamma F3 (medium) + F1 (low) from TASK-005 review. F3: the insufficient-balance check in LoyaltyDB.redeem() happens BEFORE prisma.$transaction, which means two concurrent redemptions can both pass the check and cause a negative balance. Move the check inside the transaction OR add a Postgres CHECK constraint (amount >= 0 on Customer.loyaltyPoints). F1: app/api/marketplace/loyalty/route.ts:73 and :119 require ['admin','cajero'] but ADR-024 §Step 6 specifies ['admin','owner','cajero']. Add the owner role.
acceptance_criteria: Balance check lives inside prisma.$transaction for redeem()
Concurrent-redemption stress test added to __tests__/loyalty-db.test.ts — two simultaneous redeems of 60 on a balance of 100 must fail one of them
requireAdmin(['admin','owner','cajero']) on loyalty GET and POST
tsc clean, vitest green, lint clean

tasks.title: Migrate direct Customer.loyaltyPoints writes to LoyaltyDB ledger
tasks.description: Gamma F4 (medium) from TASK-005 review. Two sites still mutate Customer.loyaltyPoints directly, bypassing the LoyaltyTransaction ledger: lib/db/customers.db.ts:216 and app/api/orders/route.ts:204. That means those operations won't be recorded in the audit trail and the materialized balance will drift from the ledger. Replace the direct writes with LoyaltyDB.earn/redeem calls so every movement flows through the ledger.
acceptance_criteria: No direct writes to Customer.loyaltyPoints outside lib/db/loyalty.db.ts (grep confirmation)
Add guard test: assert that for any LoyaltyTransaction row, Customer.loyaltyPoints equals the sum of LoyaltyTransaction.amount for that customer
tsc clean, vitest green

claim_protocol.description: Agent reads orchestrator.json, picks a task with status=pending and agent in allowed_agents, writes status=in_progress + assigned_agent + started_at, saves the file. If two agents race, the second agent's diff fails and it picks another task.

review_protocol.description: When beta marks a task as status=review, gamma picks it up, runs verification_commands, and either flips to done (with reviewed_by=gamma + completed_at) or back to in_progress with a review_notes field.
